programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Aimed at the adventure seeker, Departures is an action-packed and personal journey about two travelers. Scott Wilson and Justin Lukach leave their lives behind in search of unique experiences through some of the most beautiful and remote places on earth.

programme.title: Follow Alana Switzerland
programme.desc: Follow Alana Switzerland highlights the pastoral beauty of Switzerland's countryside and alpine scapes, delving into iconic Swiss culture and giving viewers a glimpse of what it's like to travel in the country's rural and urban settings.

programme.title: Leave No Trace
programme.desc: Ancient Siam meets privacy and 'Intelligent Luxury' at Soneva Kiri, an award-winning luxury resort located on Thailand's 4th largest island, Koh Kood. Soneva are a thriving community working closely with the environment to craft incredible bespoke experiences, where discovery is a way of life. Richard learns about Soneva's "waste to wealth" policy, and visits Mandalay to learn more about the Soneva Foundation's Myanmar Stoves Campaign.

programme.title: Gourmet Escapes
programme.desc: Chef Massimo Capra explores the Belle Isle area, one of the most beautiful settings in Northern Ireland. He meets-up with Chef Liz Moore and together they find giant sized rhubarb plants (really, they are taller than Massimo), meet the local butcher to get a pork belly and they make special sausages. Chef Liz has previously prepared a meal or two for the Queen of England. The Pressure is on Chef Massimo. Both have fun preparing a feast that will be served for a very elegant array of guests in a Royal dining room no less…this will be a meal fit for royalty!

programme.title: Gourmet Escapes
programme.desc: The village of Lunenburg is known as the fishing capital of Canada. Chef Massimo joins forces with his friend Chef Konrad Haumering who gets the freshest mussels, halibut, lobster, scallops right off of the fishermen’s boats as they are brought in daily. All this happens within a short walk from his restaurant, truly right in front of his doors. They get the fresh catch of the day, a huge Flounder fish and they accentuate the meal by adding lobster. Massimo injects his Italian influence into the cooking while Chef Konrad adds his German flare resulting in a perfect ocean treat for their guests.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints
programme.desc: To educate our children about the profound impact of travel we travel to Miami, Florida. We'll learn about the area's colorful history, taste test its cuisine and salsa dance the night away - if we can make it out of these alligator infested waters first!

programme.title: WaterVoyagers
programme.desc: Embark on a breathtaking voyage as WaterVoyagers makes its highly anticipated debut. This immersive travel series follows two American hosts, Tinabeth Pina and Frances Kuo, as they set sail on two Century Cruise ships along the legendary Yangtze River. From heart-racing adventures onshore to the lavish experiences aboard, WaterVoyagers offers a front-row seat to the ultimate travel escapade.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: New Zealand From Above
programme.desc: An aerial journey over New Zealand from the deep south of the South Island to the northern tip of the North Island. We discover the landscapes and meet New Zealanders who talk about their work, interests, and culture.
